title: The incidence and implications of aldosterone breakthrough
funder: not read: the publisher page is not accessible and the PubMed abstract carries no funding statement.
result: ACE inhibitors and angiotensin receptor blockers do not uniformly suppress the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system: plasma aldosterone is raised in a subset of treated patients ('aldosterone escape' or 'breakthrough'). The phenomenon has been examined directly only in small numbers of patients, and how often it occurs and whether it worsens outcomes have not been definitively answered; the authors judge the evidence insufficient to support widespread screening.
